reason: Applies the prediction-level needs-stale judgement, which found two of three Needs contradicted rather than merely unfulfilled. The open-weight lead expected to ship a 20-30B dense long-context model at parity produced nothing across its entire runway, a non-delivery this prediction's bridges have recorded repeatedly since 2026-04-24, so that Need is re-cut around who is actually carrying the dense mid-size lineage: extreme quantization of the existing 27B model down to a handset memory budget. The sparse-flagship Need is being actively falsified - bridge validation.4da3baa71b68ddbc (2026-07-16) has a 975B sparse flagship positioned as a customizable enterprise base routed into a fine-tuning platform, and the 2026-07-17 open sparse release took first place on a frontend coding arena - both competing on the exact coding and customization axes the Need predicted they would vacate, so it is rewritten to describe the contest that is happening rather than the retreat that is not. The on-prem Need is updated for bridge validation.c4ed70582c2e6c09 (2026-07-18), where a sparse model streams routed experts off disk on a machine with no GPU, which loosens the VRAM floor the recipe anchors on. All three windows are moved into Q3 2026; they previously closed 2026-06-30, the day before the prediction's target window opened, so this is a genuine timing correction.
